The '''carbon-scored troop transport''' was a spacecraft used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="SW60:SS" />

==History==
The vessel was used during a [[Skirmish on Spindrift|raid]] on [[Spindrift Station]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. It arrived after the station had been neutralized to pick up surviving [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] personnel as prisoners of war. After [[Flying Bantha Squadron]] picked up the route coordinates for the Empire's [[secret armada]], the transport accompanied the [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] back to [[Arbra/Legends|Arbra]].<ref name="SW60:SS" />
